browser-use / browser-harness

Issues Pull requests Releases
Browser Harness connects an LLM directly to a real browser with a thin, editable CDP harness. It is useful for automating real web workflows and accumulating domain skills.

README

Install with uv or pip, start Chrome with remote debugging, then connect the harness to the browser.

Installation

uv sync && python -m browser_harness

Domain Skills

Domain skills capture reusable selectors, flows, and edge cases for common websites.
